Here’s how to troubleshoot this as efficiently as possible:

1. Double‑check inside the app/online banking  
   - Look for a “Accounts” or “View all accounts” or “Hidden/Inactive accounts” option.

   When you call/chat, say something like:  
   “My regular checking account isn’t showing in the app or on my profile, and third‑party access can’t see any of my accounts either. Please verify that my checking account is still open, and that it’s linked and visible to my online profile. I need my **current and available balance**.”
